public.title: Sliding Window Rate Limiter
public.description: Return allow/deny booleans for nondecreasing integer request times 0 through 10000. Allow at most limit accepted requests in the interval (time-window,time], counting the current request; rejected requests do not occupy capacity. limit is 1 through 20 and window is 1 through 1000. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.
hints: Remove accepted requests exactly one window old before checking capacity.

explanation: Track only accepted timestamps, expire the open left boundary, and append allowed requests. With array shifting O(n squared) worst-case time and O(n) space. This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
